title: Reflection-Positivity Research Questions
exact_target: Explain and extend reflection positivity across its field-theoretic, algebraic, geometric and probabilistic appearances.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30002744 (OWR-13357-003). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Mini-Workshop: Reflection Positivity in Representation Theory, Stochastics and Physics (2014), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2014/55, pp. 3059--3102. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 39, 40.

status_qualification: This is the report\textquotesingle s bundled problem list. All requested connections, realizations and removal of growth assumptions are preserved below; the common-core question is programmatic and no unlisted set of axioms is supplied as an alleged original theorem. The full primary list also asks for a Lax--Phillips-type normal form for one-parameter groups whose positive part preserves a standard real subspace, reflection positivity in situations without a Euclidean Hilbert space, and duality for multiple reflection-positive involutions. It asks about multiparticle cluster-expansion spectra beyond a mass gap, and OS--Wightman equivalence without growth estimates or regularity assumptions. These specific directions are retained as additional source context to the condensed catalogue wording. The report explicitly distinguishes deep open problems from background questions in its list.
